title: NAVE | Premium Pisco from Ica, Peru
metaDescription: Discover NAVE: pure Quebranta pisco, handcrafted in Ica and dressed by hand by Nancy Ventura. Three editions: Donaire, Sunqu and Nii.
textNodes: Please confirm you are 18 or older to enter.
The soul of Peru in every drop
Pure Quebranta pisco, handcrafted in Ica and dressed by hand by Nancy Ventura.
Nii · Nii · Nii · Nii · Nii · Nii
The bearing of the chalán horseman and the grace of the marinera dance inspire Donaire: a tribute to Peru’s coast in white and red.
Nancy shapes the poncho and chullo of Sunqu, an edition that celebrates the colour and weaving of the Andes.
The earth tones, linework and headdress of Nii evoke the rainforest. An invitation to discover every detail.
Donaire, Sunqu and Nii share the same pure Quebranta pisco from Ica.
Select an edition or choose all three. Each bottle comes in its own gift box.
Drag the bottle to turn it

NAVE was born from Nancy Ventura and her bond with Ica. The pisco from her farm and the garments she makes by hand come together in a collection that celebrates Peru’s coast, highlands and rainforest.
Our pisco is handcrafted on Nancy’s farm. It is pure Quebranta: a single grape variety for all three editions.
Born in Ica, Nancy Ventura gives NAVE its name and makes the garments and accessories that dress each bottle.
Donaire, Sunqu and Nii differ only in their garments, inspired by three regions of the country. Each one is a way to discover Peru through Nancy’s craft.
Each garment, a way to tell the story of Peru.
Each bottle, an invitation to share.
Its value lies in where the pisco comes from and in the hands that dress each bottle.
Made in Ica. Dressed by hand.
Pure Quebranta pisco · 750 ml · €40 · Gift box included
